name: Swan Prep
description: Lying on your front with hands under your shoulders, lengthen and lift your chest into a gentle back extension, then lower.

source.title: Swan Prep on the Mat (Online Pilates Classes)
source.note: Classic Pilates mat exercise, described in our own words for this library. Stick-figure approximation.

setup: Lie face down with your hands under your shoulders and legs together.
cues: Lengthen first, then lift; think of reaching your head forward.
Keep your hips on the mat.
Lift only as high as feels comfortable in your lower back.

prescription.note: Move with your breath, slowly and with control.

keyframes.name: Lift your chest
keyframes.cue: Press gently and lift your chest.
